notes: Encoded in full from this brand's own page; no usesStylesOf and no cross-import from Knight, Knight XL, or any other Lochinvar page, even though the Lochinvar pages carry identical text — this is a separate entry with its own page, per the slice brief (cf. the copper-fin / copper-fin-2 precedent). The page states these styles were utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems, but that shared-use statement is not used as a reuse claim. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both chart-only — no text-verified field, so no year-only file for it) and page Style 7 (year = 2nd or 2nd & 3rd letters, chart-only; month numbers alone cannot carry a file without a year). Styles 3-6 ship YEAR-ONLY because their month is a chart-only 1st letter. All shipped style patterns are disjoint by shape/length.

styles.notes: Page example shown as '11 42N012345'; spaces stripped by normalization. Year = 1st & 2nd positions [0,2], week = 3rd & 4th positions [2,4] (1-based converted).
Page example shown as J-930001; dash stripped by normalization. Year = 1st & 2nd digits [1,3] on the normalized serial. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Page example shown as 'A 07H00123456'; spaces stripped by normalization. Year = 1st & 2nd digits [1,3]. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.

Page example shown as 'M 78013'; space stripped by normalization. Year = 1st & 2nd digits [1,3]. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Page example shown as '12345697 08'; space stripped by normalization. Year = 7th & 8th digits [6,8], month = 9th & 10th digits [8,10], as stated on this page.

Page example shown as '85 041234'; space stripped by normalization. Year = 1st & 2nd digits [0,2], month = 3rd & 4th digits [2,4], as stated on this page. This style appears in text on this page (2023 revision), so it ships from this page; no style is imported from, or withheld because of, any other Lochinvar page.
